provenance_note: Official response of the National Diet Library's Diet minutes API (JSON, UTF-8), served with Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store; the JSON carries no timestamp, session token or request echo, so it is not generated per request. Researcher (part A): downloaded on 28 September 2026 (UTC) at 14:13:58Z (plain, r1, 483933 bytes, sha256 b0397d9eb157); 14:14:01Z (cache-busting query, r1, 483933 bytes, sha256 b0397d9eb157); 14:52:09Z (plain, r2, 483933 bytes, sha256 b0397d9eb157), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. Downloaded on 28 September 2026 (UTC) by this packet at 15:34:42Z and 16:09:30Z, 34 minutes apart, and at 16:13:24Z (cache-busting query), each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, emblems, seals, signatures, scanned pages or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: The Diet minutes API's JSON for the whole meeting record of the 衆議院 予算委員会 第1号 (1990-10-19), a transcription of the House's printed minutes; the exact API URL whose bytes were hashed is recorded, and the readable minutes page is https://kokkai.ndl.go.jp/txt/111905261X00119901019. The printed page images, served through a JavaScript viewer, were not viewed. Statements are used only where a party officer speaks of the party office. Whole-meeting record (api/meeting) of the House of Representatives Budget Committee of 19 October 1990 (345 speeches). Recorded at meeting level because the party-officer identification and the statement are in different speeches: speech 131 is by 山口鶴男 (日本社会党・護憲共同); in speech 327 another member (米沢隆, 民社党) refers to "山口書記長", so the record identifies 山口鶴男 as the party's 書記長 on that day. Only the recollection of the party leaders' meeting is imported.

visual_review.method: Diet minutes API JSON decoded and the cited speeches read in full; no page images viewed.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: 山口鶴男, whom the same record identifies as secretary-general ('先ほど山口書記長の意見でも', speech 327), recalls in speech 131 a party leaders' meeting (党首会談) with the Prime Minister on 'August 22' (八月二十二日; no year printed), attended for the party by '土井委員長、私、大出国対委員長'.

locator.speaker: 山口鶴男 (131); 米沢隆 (327, identifies him as 山口書記長)

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the chair of 日本社会党 (委員長) and, from the January 1996 renaming, the party leader of 社会民主党 (党首), for CLAUDE-C01-29 only, 1990-2026. Party elections and selections, notices, filings, counts and declarations, convention approvals, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced, submitted, accepted and withdrawn resignations, stated ends, acting arrangements, predecessor references, the renaming, the 2020 convention decision and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a schedule, a filing by several candidates, an organization event, an acting leader). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial and Speaker offices, parliamentary groups and other party offices are excluded: no row feeds them, and none of their claims feeds this office. Organization identities stay unresolved; no row maps or merges 日本社会党, 社会民主党 or any other party.
